messages:
sara: Heads-up — targeting stockholm-1 go-live next week. Need owners for routing, KMS, egress, and legal sign-off. Can folks confirm responsibilities + any blockers? :wave:

jake: I can own routing/BGP. FW rules are staged in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — awaiting review. Important ports: 179 (BGP), 500/4500 (IPsec). BGP snippet below:
```
router bgp 65001
  neighbor 10.0.0.1 remote-as 65002
  neighbor 10.0.0.1 ebgp-multihop 2
  network 10.64.0.0/20
```

oliver: infra PR to provision instances is still draft, blocked by cloud quota in eu-north region. Opened support ticket #12345 with cloud provider, ETA ~24h. pinging @jake for address prefixes we should reserve.

maya: Security note — KMS key provisioning requires customer-approved key policy for residency. @liz can legal confirm if our standard key template covers stockholm?

liz: Quick read: current key policy needs data-residency clause v2 appended. I can sign off once product confirms persisted PII handling. @paul?

paul: Product: payloads must remain in-region; only metadata + aggregated logs can flow out. We'll update privacy doc and send sign-off by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved for stockholm-1: 2025-06-12 00:00-06:00 UTC. Canary ticket: https://go/redwood/canary/6789.

sara: Canaries look good. @oliver can you confirm runbook owner and who will be oncall during the canary?

oliver: I'll be runbook owner for the cutover. Oncall rotation for canary: @jake (network), @maya (security), me (infra).

jake: Pushed a small BGP tweak to the routing PR, please ack. Also need confirmation on NAT translation ranges — opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/483

maya: Quick security checklist: KMS keys created, audit logging enabled, egress ACLs in place, data-class tagging applied. Please add a +1 reaction when each item is complete.

sara: Timeline: prep Mon/Tue, canary Thu 2025-06-12, full rollout Fri if no regressions. Any blockers that need escalation now?

liz: I'll draft the legal sign-off doc and drop the link in this thread when ready.

paul: One product ask — feature-flag to prefer stockholm for EU users. Is that a routing config change or a code rollout? @sara

sara: It's a config toggle in the routing service (no code change). I'll open the PR and include migration notes.

oliver: Acknowledged. Runbook and ops notes now at https://docs.redwood/ops/stockholm-go-live.md — please review.

jake: Quick question — are TLS terminations in-region? If yes we need cert-renew window scheduled during prep.

maya: Certs terminate in-region. I'll schedule renew and rotation for Tue AM and enable strict mTLS for internal service-to-service traffic during the canary.

sara: Thanks all. I'll compile action items and post a follow-up summary. :memo: 

(react annotations: jake added :white_check_mark: to routing PR; oliver reacted :rocket: to canary reservation)
